title: Phitive
description: Many interesting plants and things will appear
body:
The mod adds two new unique plants:
- Exploberry - you can easily find it in caves, but be careful. If you try to break it, it will explode and hit other nearby berries, destroying the area. However, you can use this to your advantage, as some resources may survive.

- Florwood is an ancient tree that can appear on your tree farm. At one point in time, past civilizations managed to clear the world of this weed, but it's eager to return, so be careful. Once it emerges and matures, it begins to grow vigorously before your eyes, spreading its roots. But it has a weak spot—its heart. You should cut it down as soon as possible, otherwise the roots will spread throughout the world. Or you can use it for your own purposes.

The mod also includes achievements to help you learn new things.

In the next updates I plan to add new paintings, new plants (possibly new biomes in which these plants will grow), the use of florwood leaves as an ingredient for ointments (a new type of potion), adding a vertical part for florwood

You can contact me via Discord liveent7688. I speak EN/RU. I am open to your comments or ideas
